title: KeyChain capability token
description: Header and payload of the compact EdDSA JWS a minted agent presents to a relying party such as IAC-Bus. The token replaces a shared bus secret with a per-agent, capability-scoped, expiring credential.

kid.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the signing key: the agent's own key for a self-contained token, the trust root's for an authority-signed one.

kcc.description: Certificate chain from leaf to self-signed root. Present only in self-contained tokens, which is what lets a relying party verify with no network call.

iss.description: Issuer reference: a logical handle, or root:<name>.

sub.description: Canonical agent_uuid, the value IAC-Bus stores against every message.

caps.description: Never wider than the leaf certificate's capability set.

root.description: Key id of the trust root this token chains to, so a verifier can select the right anchor before doing any crypto.
